macrolide;streptogramin MsrE is an ABC-F subfamily protein expressed to Klebsiella pneumoniae that confers resistance to erythromycin and streptogramin B antibiotics. It is associated with plasmid DNA. It is also 100% identical to ABC-F type ribosomal protection protein Msr(E) which is in multiple species.
sulfonamide Sul2 is a sulfonamide resistant dihydropteroate synthase of Gram-negative bacteria, usually found on small plasmids.
macrolide mphE is a macrolide phosphotransferase and resistance gene identified on a plasmid, pRSB105.

carbapenem;cephalosporin;penicillin_beta-lactam GES-1 is a beta-lactamase found in Klebsiella pneumoniae.
aminoglycoside AAC(3)-Id is an aminoglycoside acetyltransferase encoded by genomic islands and integrons in S. enterica, P. mirabilis and Vibrio fluvialis.
diaminopyrimidine dfrA1 is an integron-encoded dihydrofolate reductase.

penicillin_beta-lactam OXA-36 is a beta-lactamase. Name originally from the historical Lahey list of beta-lactamases, some of which did not include sequence data.
sulfonamide Sul1 is a sulfonamide resistant dihydropteroate synthase of Gram-negative bacteria. It is linked to other resistance genes of class 1 integrons.
disinfecting_agents_and_antiseptics A subunit of the qac multidrug efflux pump in Vibrio cholerae.
aminoglycoside AAC(6')-IIa is an aminoglycoside acetyltransferase encoded by plasmids and integrons in P. aeruginosa and S. enterica.
disinfecting_agents_and_antiseptics QacE is a resistance gene conferring resistance to antiseptics.
phenicol catQ is a chromosome-encoded variant of the cat gene found in Clostridium perfringens.

phenicol floR is a plasmid or chromosome-encoded chloramphenicol exporter that is found in Bordetella bronchiseptica, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium str. DT104 and Vibrio cholerae.

aminoglycoside APH(3')-Ia is a transposon-encoded aminoglycoside phosphotransferase in E. coli and S. enterica. It is identical at the protein sequence to APH(3')-Ic, an aminoglycoside phosphotransferase encoded by plasmids, transposons and genomic islands in K. pneumoniae, A. baumannii, S. marcescens, Corynebacterium spp., Photobacterium spp. and Citrobacter spp.
